title: 第一卷 第19章 从中作梗
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
张海洋以为自己看花眼了。

    揉好眼睛，定睛一看，的确就是海参！

    他伸手想把海参捞起来，结果刚把海参拿起来，发现下面还有海参。

    一扒拉。

    惊的差点一屁股坐在地上。

    他抬起头看向张春妮，问道：“春……春妮，这水桶里咋这么多海参？”

    张春妮；“滩涂地赶海抓的。”

    “我一共才抓了十一个。”

    “不算多吧。”

    她这么说可不是谦虚或者装比，因为李华可抓的比她多多了。

    张海洋激动的喊道：“这还不多？”

    “你知道这个有多值钱吗？”

    “一只就能卖一百来块钱！”

    张春妮惊的后退半步。

    这么值钱？

    这一只海参都够给阿奶挂一个月的水了？

    正打算走的荣光飞听到喊声，赶紧跑过来：“海参？”

    “我看看。”

    “这么多，还这么大只！”

    “靓货啊。”

    他见猎心喜：“靓女，卖给我。”

    “我全要。”

    张春妮看向李华。

    李华咳嗽一声，问道：“老板怎么称呼？”

    “荣光飞。”

    “你好，荣老板，我叫李华。”

    “靓仔，你好，你好。”

    “看你这好像在求购海参啊？”

    “不瞒你说，的确是。”

    “需要多少？”

    “一百只，你能帮忙搞到吗？”

    “问题不大啊。”李华笑了笑，说道：“我抓的时候也没数，拎着有个大几十斤。”

    “算算也大差不差。”

    “阿青。”

    阿青把另一个蛇皮袋的口打开，随手掏出两只海参，一手一个，然后咧嘴笑道：“这一袋子里都是海参。”

    所有人都傻了。

    一蛇皮袋的海参？

    荣光飞目瞪口呆：“真……真的？”

    他这些天为了找海参，那可是求爷爷告奶奶，就算是这样，还是没有搞定，就在要绝望的时候，俩小年轻拎着一蛇皮袋的海参出现了。

    这是老天爷派来拯救他的吗？

    李华笑道：“那还能有假？”

    “不信倒出来验货咯。”

    “海洋哥。”
content_en:
Zhang Haiyang thought he was blinded.

    Rub your eyes and take a closer look, it is indeed a sea cucumber!

    He stretched out his hand to pick up the sea cucumber, but as soon as he picked it up, he found that there were still sea cucumbers underneath.

    One pull.

    He was so shocked that he almost sat down on the ground.

    He raised his head and looked at Zhang Chuni and asked: "Chun...Chunni, why are there so many sea cucumbers in this bucket?"

    Zhang Chunni; "Caught from the tidal flats."

    "I only caught eleven in total."

    "It's not much."

    She was not being modest or pretentious when she said this, because Li Huake had caught many more people than she had.

    Zhang Haiyang shouted excitedly: "Isn't this much?"

    "Do you know how valuable this is?"

    "One can be sold for more than a hundred yuan!"

    Zhang Chuni took half a step back in shock.

    So valuable?

    Is this one sea cucumber enough to keep Grandma covered in water for a month?

    Rong Guangfei, who was about to leave, heard the shouting and ran over quickly: "Sea cucumber?"

    "Let me see."

    "So many, and such a big one!"

    "Beautiful product."

    He was delighted when he saw Hunting Heart: "Beautiful girl, sell it to me."

    "I want them all."

    Zhang Chuni looked at Li Hua.

    Li Hua coughed and asked, "What do you call the boss?"

    "Rong Guangfei."

    "Hello, Boss Rong, my name is Li Hua."

    "Hello, handsome boy, hello."

    "It seems like you are looking to buy sea cucumbers?"

    "To tell you the truth, it is."

    "How many do you need?"

    "One hundred, can you help me get them?"

    "It's not a big problem." Li Hua smiled and said, "I didn't even count it when I caught it. It was dozens of kilograms heavier."

    "It's pretty much the same after all."

    "Aqing."

    Ah Qing opened the mouth of another snakeskin bag and took out two sea cucumbers, one in each hand. Then he grinned and said, "This bag is full of sea cucumbers."

    Everyone was dumbfounded.

    A snakeskin bag of sea cucumbers?

    Rong Guangfei was stunned: "Really...really?"

    In order to find sea cucumbers these days, he begged his grandfather to sue his grandmother. Even so, he still couldn't get it done. Just when he was about to despair, two young men appeared carrying a snakeskin bag of sea cucumbers.

    Was this sent by God to save him?

    Li Hua smiled and said: "How can it be fake?"

    "If you don't believe me, pour it out for inspection."

    "Brother Ocean."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 19 Getting in the way
